scope: Verify whether Finolex/Ranpar private marine prices reported by GAC on 2023-09-07 remain operative; attributable HTML accepted, no PDF requirement.

result.interpretation: The five amounts are verified as GAC's dated report. They are not shown to have expired, and this search did not find a successor. Neither fact proves no private or unindexed amendment occurred.

prices.unit: per hour vessel stay in port

newChecks.source: J M Baxi Marine Services circular index
newChecks.relevance: Public agency notice archive maintained into the current month; raw HTML and web extraction searched for Finolex, Ranpar, Pawas and Ratnagiri.
newChecks.outcome: No Finolex/Ranpar/Pawas text. Ratnagiri entries concern monsoon restrictions and reopening (2021, 2023, 2024), not revised service prices.
newChecks.limit: Archive is not guaranteed to contain every private terminal circular.

newChecks.outcome: Current agency location/contact page; no tariff or pricing displayed. Does not corroborate amounts.

newChecks.source: Silver Port Services operator service page
newChecks.outcome: Continues to identify Finolex Sea Terminal among managed facilities, with pilotage, tugs and mooring services. No price schedule or revision date.
Accessible search extraction identifies separate liquid and coal facilities, operator and marine particulars. No prices; recent crawl is not tariff currentness.
Public port section identifies technical information and MARPOL reception resources only. No new marine charge schedule located in this follow-up.

newChecks.source: J M Baxi port directory and estimated disbursement service
newChecks.outcome: Public directory request redirects to homepage with login controls; EPDA did not expose an anonymous quote. No sign-up, login bypass or estimate request submitted.

newChecks.source: Atlantic Global Shipping public site and indexed pages
newChecks.outcome: Agency information and member login; no indexed Ratnagiri/Finolex price page found.

searchCoverage.included: Finolex, Ranpar, Pawas, Ratnagiri, Silver Port Services; later year/revision/service-charge wording; berth/pilotage/towage/PDA/disbursement terms; agency directories and public examples; domain-limited searches for ISS, Wilhelmsen, Atlantic, Marcons and Parekh.
searchCoverage.excludedAsFalsePositives: Finolex Cables retail prices, electricity tariffs for Ranpar substations, company loan charges, current crawl timestamps on old documents, other ports in Ratnagiri district.
searchCoverage.saturation: Later rounds returned the same dated GAC report, historical compilations, facility descriptions, or unrelated tariffs. No independent current-period price evidence emerged.

sourceUseRecommendation.acceptableLabel: Latest publicly located Finolex marine rates: GAC report dated 7 September 2023; checked 18 October 2026; no later public revision found.
sourceUseRecommendation.unacceptableLabel: Confirmed current October 2026 tariff / complete Finolex invoice.

firecrawl.toolAvailability: No Firecrawl/crawl/scrape tool exposed in the researcher's available tools.
firecrawl.usefulness: The known GAC page is already readable and its date was visually recovered. Current blocker is independent newer price evidence, not extraction of that page. A different crawler may discover additional pages but cannot certify unchanged rates merely by re-scraping the same report.
